Look at the information, listen to your teacher and repeat the expressions. Discuss about them.
IDIOM
MEANING
EXAMPLE
GET ON THE BANDWAGON
To join an activity that has become very popular.
The success of the product led many firms to try to get on the bandwagon.
KEEP THE CHIN UP
To be stalwart and courageous in a tough situation.
Don't let the difficulties intimidate you; keep your chin up.
WALK OUT ON
To suddenly leave a job, a relationship or other situation.
Everyone was shocked when he walked out on his wife of fourteen year.
COME OUT SWINGING
To be confrontational.
He came out swinging at his critics, accusing them of having their own agenda.
BEEF UP
To become big and muscular.
We need to find some new players to beef up the team.
TURN ASIDE
To refuse entry to somewhere.
His job application was turned aside when they saw his criminal record.
TIDE OVER
Temporary help (often financial)
Have another piece of cake. It'll tide you over till supper.
CRACK UP
Go through an emotional breakdown.
The entire group cracked up at the joke of their teacher.

slideDifferences.nativeText:
To Consider 
1. Verb + Preposition combination receive the stress on the verb particle. 
2. Verb + Adverb combination receives the stress on the adverb particle. 
3. Verb + Adverb + Preposition combination receives the stress on the adverb particle
4. Some phrasal verbs may be separable. That is to say, the object goes in the middle of the particles. This mainly happens when the object is a pronoun. E.G. We need to call it off.
5. Separable phrasal verbs work also together. E.G. We called off the meeting.

Examples

texts: B. Listen to the audio and answer the questions your teacher makes.

Have you ever met someone who is so annoying that you can not stand him? I think we all have. Coming across with such a character and having him around may make us shout at some point ‘hey man, knock it off! However, being in peace with everyone is something we all must go for. We need to bear in mind that each person is different so that brings up different situations to deal with. Nevertheless, neither disrespect nor abuse should be born from anyone, so we need to set limits and boundaries.
